annotations.title: Where to buy a chosen product

description: Use this when the user has already chosen a product (or a few) and wants to know where to buy it or to compare its price across shops: for example after you recommended a model. Pass each product as brand + model, the way it is sold (e.g. 'Cecotec Conga 3790', 'Bosch GSB 18V-55'), or its EAN/GTIN barcode if you know it (exact match); up to 5 products in one call. For each product, `coincidencia` is 'exacta' (SeeStocks has that product: `ofertas` lists every Spanish online shop that sells it, cheapest first, with price, shipping (`envio_eur` null = unknown, not free), total and link, plus the 90-day price `historial`), 'aproximada' (no exact match: `candidatos` may be other products, never present them as the requested one unless the name clearly matches) or 'no_encontrado' (say SeeStocks does not have it). Prices in euros.

productos.description: 1 to 5 products: brand + model, or EAN/GTIN.
